definition: to keep the air in your lungs on purpose
description: On the bottom of a swimming pool, a young man with spiky black hair, in a black tuxedo and bow tie, sits at a table laid with a white cloth and pinches his nose shut, keeping his mouth closed, with his eyes wide. Around the table other young people in evening dresses and suits sit underwater, laughing, chatting and raising glasses as bubbles rise from them. Tall white candles stand on the table, a bowl of apples floats upwards and lane ropes stretch across the surface above.
